phrases.english: You are stronger than you think.
Feel your feet, on the ground.
Believe in yourself, you can do it.
Let your mind wander, then focus.
Learn a little, grow a lot.
Try again, you can do it.
I can learn, step by step.
Mistakes are okay, I am learning.
You are my best friend, always.
Hello there, nice to meet you.
I am lost. Can you help?
My love, for you, is deep.
You are doing great, keep it up.
I made a mistake, please let it go.
I regret my actions, please forgive.
phrases.transliteration: nanna krutya galige vishadissuttene, dayavittu kshamisi.

phrases.english: Listen more, speak less, understand all.
phrases.kannada: ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಕೇಳಿ, ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾತನಾಡಿ, ಎಲ್ಲವನ್ನೂ ಅರಿತುಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.
phrases.transliteration: hechchu keli, kamiya maatanaadi, ellavannu aritukolli.

phrases.english: Patience, my friend, brings great rewards.
Small steps forward, always win the race.
Learn from yesterday, live today, plan tomorrow.
phrases.kannada: ನಿನ್ನೆ ಕಲಿಯಿರಿ, ಇಂದು ಬಾಳಿ, ನಾಳೆ ಯೋಜಿಸಿ.
phrases.transliteration: ninne kaliyiri, indu baali, naale yojisi.

phrases.english: Kindness costs nothing, but is priceless.
Build your knowledge, word by word.
My life, is better, with you.
Forever, with you, is my wish.
My voice matters, when I speak.
I am proud, of my effort.
Truth, even if bitter, is always best.
One good deed, spreads far and wide.
Gratitude, opens many doors for you.
I hope you can forgive me.
I'll do better next time, please forgive.
phrases.kannada: ಮುಂದೆ ನಾನು ಉತ್ತಮವಾಗಿ ಮಾಡುತ್ತೇನೆ, ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ಕ್ಷಮಿಸಿ.
phrases.transliteration: mundu naanu uttamavaagi maaduttene, dayavittu kshamisi.

phrases.english: What a joy, such a joy!
My heart is full, so full.
Can you show me the way?
I need to find a safe place.
Where is the bus stop, please?
I need a ticket, to Mysore.
How much is this, for one person?
I want to go, to the hotel.
It will happen, when it's time.
This is the color, I want.
Imagine new worlds, draw them out.
Your ideas, let them flow freely.
Build with passion, see it grow.
I can do this, I will try.
Learning is fun, don't give up.
Mistakes are okay, learn from them.
Mistakes are lessons, learn from them.
Thanks for being there, for me.

phrases.transliteration: Tūka vanna badalāyisi, nim'ma nelaiyannu huḍuki.

phrases.english: Hello, where is the train station?
I want to go to the airport.
Slow and steady, wins the race.
phrases.transliteration: Nidhaana, aadhare khachithavaagi, geluvu nimma dhey.

phrases.english: Wait a little, it will be fine.
My heart, is full of joy.
One day at a time, you'll get there.

phrases.transliteration: Dhair yavāgi nāvīnyagoḷisi, hosa dārigalannu anvēṣisi.

phrases.english: Express yourself, through art and words.
phrases.kannada: ಕಲೆ ಮತ್ತು ಪದಗಳ ಮೂಲಕ, ನಿಮ್ಮನ್ನು ವ್ಯಕ್ತಪಡಿಸಿ.
phrases.transliteration: Kale mattu padagaḷa mūlaka, nim'mannu vyaktapaḍisi.

phrases.english: Let inspiration strike, capture the moment.
Dream big, then make it real.
phrases.kannada: ದೊಡ್ಡ ಕನಸು ಕಾಣಿ, ನಂತರ ಅದನ್ನು ನಿಜವಾಗಿಸಿ.
phrases.transliteration: Doḍḍa kanasu kāṇi, nantara adannu nijavāgisi.

phrases.english: Peace is a choice, choose it.
Can I see the menu, please?
Every word counts, try to say it.
phrases.kannada: ಪ್ರತಿ ಪದವೂ ಮುಖ್ಯ, ಅದನ್ನು ಹೇಳಲು ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸಿ.
phrases.transliteration: prati padavu mukhya, adannu helalu prayatnisi.

phrases.english: I understand a little, I'm improving.
Ask me questions, I will answer.
This is new, but I'm learning.
Let your thoughts wander, then capture them.
phrases.kannada: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಆಲೋಚನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಅಲೆದಾಡಲು ಬಿಡಿ, ನಂತರ ಸೆರೆಹಿಡಿಯಿರಿ.
phrases.transliteration: nimma aalochane galannu aledaaḍalu biḍi, nantara serehiḍiyiri.

phrases.kannada: ಸಹನೆಯನ್ನು ಅಭ್ಯಾಸ ಮಾಡಿ, ಅದು ಫಲ ನೀಡುತ್ತದೆ.
phrases.transliteration: sah aneyannu abhyāsa māḍi, adu phala nīḍuttade.

phrases.english: Help me, please, I need assistance
phrases.kannada: ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡಿ, ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು, ನನಗೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಬೇಕು
phrases.transliteration: sahaya maadi, dayavittu, nanage sahaya beku

phrases.english: I am hurt, please, call an ambulance
phrases.kannada: ನನಗೆ ಗಾಯವಾಗಿದೆ, ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು, ಅಂಬುಲೆನ್ಸ್ ಕರೆ ಮಾಡಿ
phrases.transliteration: nanage gாயa vaagide, dayavittu, ambulance kare maadi

phrases.english: Where is the nearest hospital, please?

phrases.kannada: ನಿಲ್ಲಿ, ಕಳ್ಳನೆ, ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು, ನನಗೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡಿ
phrases.transliteration: nill i, kal'lane, dayavittu, nanage sahaya maadi

phrases.english: Call your mother, come home now
phrases.kannada: ಅಮ್ಮಗೆ ಕರೆ ಮಾಡಿ, ಈಗಲೇ ಮನೆಗೆ ಬಾ
phrases.transliteration: ammage kare maadi, eegale manege baa

phrases.english: Father, please listen, I’m telling you
Ask your sibling, we can help
phrases.kannada: ನಿನ್ನ ಸಹೋದರನಿಗೆ ಕೇಳು, ನಾವು ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತೇವೆ
phrases.transliteration: ninna sahodaranige kelu, naavu sahaaya maaduttve

phrases.english: Grandpa, tell stories, we enjoy them
Hello, how are you today, my friend?
Hi there, welcome, have a great day!
Good morning, please have a seat, friend.
Good evening, how is your day going?
Welcome back, you’re here today, great!
phrases.kannada: ಮತ್ತೆ ಸ್ವಾಗತ, ನೀನು ಇಂದು ಬಂದೆ, ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿದೆ!
phrases.transliteration: matte svāgata, nīnu indu bandē, chennāgide!

phrases.english: We are ready to order, now.
phrases.kannada: ನಾವು ಈಗ ಆರ್ಡರ್ ಮಾಡಲು ಸಿದ್ಧ, ಈಗಲೇ.

phrases.english: Can we see the menu, please?

phrases.transliteration: nanage hagu ra garevi beku, dayavittu.

phrases.english: Learn daily, grow steadily, keep going
phrases.transliteration: pratidina kaliyiri, nidhana vaagi beḷeyiri, munduvariyiri

phrases.english: Make mistakes, learn fast, improve again
phrases.kannada: ತಪ್ಪು ಮಾಡಿ, ತ್ವರಿತವಾಗಿ ಕಲಿಯಿರಿ, ಮತ್ತೆ ಉತ್ತಮಪಡಿರಿ
phrases.transliteration: tappu maadi, tvaritavaagi kaliyiri, matte uttamapaḍiri

phrases.english: Start with one step, build confidence
phrases.transliteration: ondhu hejjeyinda aarambhisi, atma vishvaasa kattiri

phrases.english: Stay patient, progress comes in time
Ask questions, deepen understanding, keep improving
phrases.kannada: ಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ ಕೇಳಿ, ಅರ್ಥವನ್ನು ಆಳವಾಗಿ ಮಾಡಿ, ಉತ್ತಮಪಡಿರಿ
phrases.transliteration: praśne keli, arthavannu aḷavaagi maadi, uttamapaḍiri

phrases.english: Believe in yourself, work daily, grow steadily
phrases.kannada: ನಿನ್ನ ಮೇಲೆ ನಂಬಿಕೆ, ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ಕೆಲಸ, ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ ಬೆಳೆಯು
phrases.transliteration: ninna mele nambike, pratidina kelasa, nidhana vagi belagu

phrases.english: Start with effort, results will follow
Small steps now, big success later
phrases.kannada: ಈಗ ಸಣ್ಣ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆ, ನಂತರ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಯಶಸ್ಸು
phrases.transliteration: ega sanna hejj e, nantara doDDa yashaSSu

phrases.english: Stay focused, keep going, you’ll succeed
phrases.kannada: ಗಮನ ಕೇಂದ್ರೀಕರಿಸು, ಮುಂದೆ ಹೋಗು, ನೀನು ಯಶಸ್ವಿಯಾಗುತ್ತೀಯೆ
phrases.transliteration: gamanakendri karisu, munde hogu, ninu yashaSwiyaguttieye

phrases.english: Learn from mistakes, turn them into wins
phrases.transliteration: tappugaLinda kaliy ut, avanne geluvagi badalisu

phrases.english: Hello, where is the bus stop, please?
Excuse me, how much is this ticket?
I need water, please, near this shop.
phrases.kannada: ನನಗೆ ನೀರು ಬೇಕು, ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು, ಈ ಅಂಗಡಿಯ ಬಳಿ.
phrases.transliteration: nanage neeru beku, dayavittu, ee aṅkiya baḷi.

phrases.english: Is this train going to Mysuru, right?
Please show me the route, step by step.

phrases.transliteration: nidhānavaagi nadiyiri, nimma hejjegaḷannu anu bhavisi

phrases.english: Hold calm, let go of worry

phrases.transliteration: neṭṭage nilli, nimma bhuja gaḷannu biḍi

phrases.english: I can learn Kannada, one day at a time
My mistakes are lessons, I will improve
I speak slowly, and I stay confident
phrases.kannada: ನಾನು ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ ಮಾತನಾಡುತ್ತೇನೆ, ನನಗೆ ಧೈರ್ಯ ಇದೆ
phrases.transliteration: naanu nidhana vaagi maataaduttēne, nanage dhairyavide

phrases.english: Every word matters, I keep going

phrases.kannada: ಉಸಿರು ಬಿಡಿ, ನೆಮ್ಮದಿಯಾಗಿ, ನಂತರ ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟವಾಗಿ ಮಾತನಾಡಿ
phrases.transliteration: usiru bidi, nemmadiyagi, nantara spashṭavagi maataadi

phrases.english: Wake up early, breathe deeply, begin calmly
phrases.kannada: ಬೆಳಗ್ಗೆ ಎದ್ದು, ಆಳವಾಗಿ ಉಸಿರೆಳೆ, ಶಾಂತವಾಗಿ ಆರಂಭಿಸಿ
phrases.transliteration: beḷagge eḍdu, āḷavāgi usireḷe, shāntavāgi ārambhisi

phrases.english: Choose patience, every day, step by step
Be grateful, release worries, smile softly
Learn from mistakes, grow stronger, keep going
Keep promises, respect others, live honestly
phrases.kannada: ವಚನ ಪಾಲಿಸಿ, ಇತರರನ್ನು ಗೌರವಿಸಿ, ಸತ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಬದುಕಿ
phrases.transliteration: vachana pālisi, itarannu gauravis i, satyavāgi baduki

phrases.english: Use imagination, try new ideas, learn fast
phrases.kannada: ಕಲ್ಪನೆ ಬಳಸಿ, ಹೊಸ ಆಲೋಚನೆ ಮಾಡಿ, ಬೇಗ ಕಲಿಯಿರಿ
phrases.transliteration: kalpane baḷasi, hosa ālocane māḍi, bega kaliyiri

phrases.english: Start with curiosity, ask why, keep exploring
phrases.kannada: ಕುತೂಹಲದಿಂದ ಆರಂಭಿಸಿ, ಏಕೆ ಎಂದು ಕೇಳಿ, ಮುಂದುವರೆಯಿರಿ
phrases.transliteration: kutūhaladinda ārambhisi, ēke endu kēḷi, mugundavarayiri

phrases.english: Sketch a dream, revise gently, smile
Mix colors, mix ideas, create something new
phrases.kannada: ಬಣ್ಣಗಳನ್ನು ಮಿಶ್ರ ಮಾಡಿ, ಆಲೋಚನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಮಿಶ್ರ ಮಾಡಿ, ಹೊಸದನ್ನು ಮಾಡಿ
phrases.transliteration: baṇṇagaḷannu misra māḍi, ālocanegaḷannu misra māḍi, hosa­dannā māḍi

phrases.english: Be brave, share your work, grow daily
phrases.kannada: ಧೈರ್ಯವಾಗಿ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕೆಲಸ ಹಂಚಿ, ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ಬೆಳೆಸಿ
phrases.transliteration: dhairyavāgi, nimma kelas hanchi, pratidina beḷesī

phrases.english: Good morning, drink water, stay calm
At noon, pause, breathe slowly, smile
phrases.kannada: ಮಧ್ಯಾಹ್ನ, ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ವಿರಾಮ, ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ ಉಸಿರು, ನಗಿರಿ
phrases.transliteration: madhyahna, svalpa viraama, nidaanavaagi usiru, nagiri

phrases.english: In the evening, finish work, then rest
Before bed, turn off lights, be grateful
phrases.transliteration: malaguva munna, dheepa aaris i, kritajnaraagir i

phrases.english: Now, start small, keep going, don’t stop
Thank you, I appreciate you deeply, today
phrases.kannada: ಧನ್ಯವಾದಗಳು, ನಾನು ನಿಮಗೆ ತುಂಬಾ ಮೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತೇನೆ, ಇಂದು
phrases.transliteration: dhanyavaadagalu, naanu nimage tumba meechchuttene, indu

phrases.english: I’m grateful, for your kindness, always
Thanks again, I feel lucky, with you
I honor your help, with gratitude, today
phrases.kannada: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಸಹಾಯಕ್ಕೆ ನಾನು ಗೌರವಿಸುತ್ತೇನೆ, ಕೃತಜ್ಞತೆಯಿಂದ, ಇಂದು
phrases.transliteration: nimma sahaayakke naanu gouravisuttene, krutajñateyinda, indu

phrases.english: Thank you, for listening, it means a lot
Two cups, share gently with friends

phrases.transliteration: mooru usiru, nimma bhujagalannu sadilis i

phrases.english: Four steps, keep your rhythm steady
phrases.transliteration: naalku hejj e, nimma layavannu sthiravaagirisi

phrases.english: Five minutes, start studying right now
phrases.transliteration: aid u nimisha, eegale odalu aarambhisi

phrases.english: Take one step, keep going, be brave
Feel fear, breathe, then move forward
Small tries, big courage, start today
phrases.kannada: ಸಣ್ಣ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನ, ದೊಡ್ಡ ಧೈರ್ಯ, ಇಂದೇ ಆರಂಭಿಸು
phrases.transliteration: sanna prayatna, doDDa dhairya, inde aarambhisu

phrases.english: Stand tall, speak kindly, face challenges
phrases.kannada: ಎದ್ದು ನಿಲ್ಲು, ಸೌಮ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಮಾತನಾಡು, ಸವಾಲುಗಳನ್ನು ಎದುರಿಸು
phrases.transliteration: eddu nillu, saumya vaagi maataadu, savaalugaLannu edurisu

phrases.english: You can do it, try again, never quit
phrases.transliteration: neenu maadabahudu, matte prayatnisu, kaibida beda

phrases.english: Breathe in, notice your body, relax
phrases.kannada: ಉಸಿರು ಒಳಗೆಳೆ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ದೇಹ ಗಮನಿಸಿ, ನೆಮ್ಮದಿ
phrases.transliteration: usiru oḷageḷe, nimma deha gamanisi, nemmadi

phrases.english: Exhale slowly, let thoughts pass by
phrases.transliteration: nidhanaŭvaagi horasuṣiri, ālochane-gaḷu hādu hōgal i

phrases.english: Feel the ground, stay present, right now
phrases.transliteration: nelavannu anu bhavis i, īgalē irali

phrases.english: Listen inward, soften your shoulders, smile
phrases.transliteration: oḷage kēḷi, bhuja-gaḷu saḍilis i, nagiri

phrases.english: Do you have this in my size,
I want to buy this today,
Can I try it on, please,
Be kind, speak softly, help today
phrases.kannada: ದಯೆಯಿಂದ ಇರಿ, ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ ಮಾತನಾಡಿ, ಇಂದು ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡಿ
phrases.transliteration: dayind i ri, nidhānavaagi māḍi, indu sāhāya māḍi

phrases.english: Smile first, you can brighten someone
Listen carefully, kindness grows in silence
phrases.transliteration: gamanavāgi kēḷi, mauṇadalli yē daye beḷeyuttade

phrases.english: Thank someone, even a small favor
Offer help, without expecting anything back
Be brave, learn fast, move forward
Slow steps, strong heart, steady progress
phrases.kannada: ನಿಧಾನ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆಗಳು, ಬಲವಾದ ಮನಸ್ಸು, ಸ್ಥಿರ ಪ್ರಗತಿ
phrases.transliteration: nidana hejjegalu, balavaada manasu, sthira pragati

phrases.english: Fall down, rise up, try again

phrases.kannada: ಈಗ ಗಮನಕೊಡಿ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮೇಲೆ ನಂಬಿಕೆ ಇಡಿ, ನಡೆ
phrases.transliteration: ee ga gamanakodi, nimme mele nambike i di, nede

phrases.english: Hello, how are you doing today?
Please, speak a little more slowly.
Thank you, you helped me a lot.
phrases.kannada: ಧನ್ಯವಾದಗಳು, ನೀವು ನನಗೆ ಬಹಳ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡಿದ್ದೀರಿ.
phrases.transliteration: dhanyavādagaḷu, nīvu nanage bahaḷa sahāya māḍiddīri.

phrases.english: Excuse me, where is the bus stop?
Believe in yourself, take one small step
phrases.kannada: ಸ್ವಯಂನಲ್ಲಿ ನಂಬಿಕೆ ಇಟ್ಟು, ಒಂದು ಚಿಕ್ಕ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆ ಇಡಿ
phrases.transliteration: svayam nalli nambike ittu, ondu chikka hejje iḍi

phrases.english: Learn slowly, grow steadily, keep going
Your effort matters, even in silence
Dream bravely, work kindly, stay humble
phrases.kannada: ಧೈರ್ಯವಾಗಿ ಕನಸು ನೋಡಿ, ದಯೆಯಿಂದ ಕೆಲಸ ಮಾಡಿ, ವಿನಮ್ರವಾಗಿರಿ
phrases.transliteration: dhairyavaagi kanasu nōdi, dayeyinda kelas māḍi, vinamravāgir i

phrases.english: Speak kindly, listen first, learn always
phrases.kannada: ಮೃದುವಾಗಿ ಮಾತನಾಡಿ, ಮೊದಲು ಕೇಳಿ, ಸದಾ ಕಲಿಯಿರಿ
phrases.transliteration: mriduvagi maataadi, modalu keli, sadaa kaliyiri

phrases.english: Dream boldly, act patiently, improve daily
phrases.kannada: ದಿಟ್ಟವಾಗಿ ಕನಸು, ತಾಳ್ಮೆಯಿಂದ ಕೆಲಸ, ದಿನವೂ ಸುಧಾರಣೆ
phrases.transliteration: dittavagi kanasu, talmeonde kelasa, dinavoo sudharane

phrases.english: Choose effort, not excuses, keep going
phrases.kannada: ನೆಪವನ್ನು ಬಿಡಿ, ಪ್ರಯತ್ನ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಮಾಡಿ, ಮುಂದುವರಿಸಿ
phrases.transliteration: nepathannu bidi, prayatna aayke maadi, munduvarisi

phrases.english: Small steps count, keep moving forward
Be grateful, share softly, grow stronger
I understand more, each time I practice
phrases.kannada: ನಾನು ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಅರ್ಥಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತೇನೆ, ನಾನು ಅಭ್ಯಾಸ ಮಾಡಿದಾಗ
phrases.transliteration: naanu hecchu arthamaadikoḷḷuttēne, naanu abhyāsa maadidāga

phrases.english: Today I try, tomorrow I will be better
phrases.kannada: ಇಂದು ನಾನು ಪ್ರಯತ್ನಿಸುತ್ತೇನೆ, ನಾಳೆ ನಾನು ಉತ್ತಮ
phrases.transliteration: indu naanu prayatnistēne, nāḷe naanu uttama

phrases.english: I trust my progress, I will not stop
phrases.kannada: ನನ್ನ ಪ್ರಗತಿಗೆ ನಂಬಿಕೆ ಇದೆ, ನಾನು ನಿಲ್ಲುವುದಿಲ್ಲ
phrases.transliteration: nanna pragatige nambike ide, naanu nilluvudillā

phrases.english: Even if I forget, I can restart
I am learning, so I belong here
My purpose is simple, serve with heart.
I learn every day, to grow purposefully.
Today, I act with purpose and kindness.
I follow my dreams, with steady effort.
Work matters most, I keep it aligned.
Break the rules, build your style, enjoy
phrases.kannada: ನಿಯಮಗಳನ್ನು ಮುರಿಯಿರಿ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಶೈಲಿ ಕಟ್ಟಿರಿ, ಆನಂದಿಸಿ
phrases.transliteration: niyamagaḷannu muriyiri, nimma shaili kaṭṭiri, ānandisi

phrases.english: Listen to silence, then write a thought
phrases.kannada: ನಿಶ್ಶಬ್ದ ಕೇಳಿ, ನಂತರ ಒಂದು ಆಲೋಚನೆ ಬರೆಯಿರಿ
phrases.transliteration: nishshabda kēḷi, natara ond u ālocane bareyiri

phrases.english: Try, fail a little, improve quickly
phrases.transliteration: prayatnis i, svalpa tapp i, bega sudhā risi

phrases.english: Reuse ideas wisely, create again, learn
phrases.kannada: ಆಲೋಚನೆಗಳನ್ನು ಜಾಣ್ಮೆಯಿಂದ ಬಳಸಿ, ಮತ್ತೆ ರಚಿಸಿ, ಕಲಿಯಿರಿ
phrases.transliteration: ālocanegaḷannu jāṇme yindā baḷasi, matte racisi, kaliyiri

phrases.english: Dream big, take one step, start now
phrases.kannada: ದೊಡ್ಡ ಕನಸು ನೋಡಿ, ಒಂದು ಹೆಜ್ಜೆ ಇಡಿ, ಈಗ ಆರಂಭಿಸಿ
phrases.transliteration: doḍḍa kanasu nōḍi, ondu hejj e iḍi, īga ārambhisi

phrases.english: Slow your thoughts, one by one

phrases.transliteration: samatōlanad d alir i, jāgarūkavaagi munduvariyiri

phrases.english: Good morning, bring your smile today
Thank you, joy fills my heart
Let’s laugh, even small things matter
Today is new, enjoy every moment
Practice daily, your skills will rise
phrases.kannada: ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸ ಮಾಡಿ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕೌಶಲ್ಯ ಹೆಚ್ಚುತ್ತದೆ
phrases.transliteration: pratidina abhyasa maadi, nimma kaushalya heccugutthade

phrases.kannada: ದೊಡ್ಡ ಕನಸು ಕಂಡಿರಿ, ಆದರೆ ನಿರಂತರವಾಗಿ ಓದಿರಿ
phrases.transliteration: doḍḍa kanasu kandi ri, aadhare nirantharavaagi oḍiri

phrases.english: Small wins matter, celebrate and continue
phrases.transliteration: chikka jaya gaḷu mahatvadu, acharisi, munduvariyiri

phrases.kannada: ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸಗಳನ್ನು ಬಿಟ್ಟು, ಉತ್ತಮ ರೂಟೀನ್ಗಳನ್ನು ಕಟ್ಟಿರಿ
phrases.transliteration: heccina abhyāsagaḷannu beḍḍi, uttama rūṭīngaḷannu kattiri

phrases.english: I forgive you, please continue kindly.
It’s okay, I choose forgiveness now.
phrases.transliteration: sari, aga nanu kshameyanun choose maduttini

phrases.english: Let go of hurt, we can heal.
Forgive me too, I didn’t mean harm.
phrases.kannada: ನನ್ನನ್ನೂ ಕ್ಷಮಿಸು, ನಾನು ಹಾನಿ ಮಾಡುವ ಉದ್ದೇಶವಿರಲಿಲ್ಲ.
phrases.transliteration: nannannu kshamisu, nanu haani maduva uddeshavir alilla

phrases.english: I understand, so I forgive you.

phrases.kannada: ಆಶೆ ಇಟ್ಟುಕೊಳ್ಳಿ, ಶಾಂತವಾಗಿ ಉಸಿರೆಳೆ, ಮುಂದೆ ಹೋಗಿ.
phrases.transliteration: aashe iddukolli, shaantavaagi usirele, munde hogi

phrases.english: Hope grows, one small step at a time.
phrases.kannada: ಆಶೆ ಬೆಳೆಯುತ್ತದೆ, ಒಂದು ಸಣ್ಣ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆ ಒಂದೊಂದು ಬಾರಿ.
phrases.transliteration: aashe beḷeyuttade, ondu saṇṇa hejjje ondondu baari

phrases.english: When tired, rest, then hope again.
phrases.kannada: ತುಂಬಾ ದಣಿದಾಗ, ವಿಶ್ರಾಂತಿ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಳ್ಳಿ, ಮತ್ತೆ ಆಶೆ.
phrases.transliteration: tumba daṇidaaga, vishraaanti tegedukolli, matte aashe

phrases.english: Hold hope close, let fear fade.
Hope is quiet, but it guides.
Dream with hope, work with joy, rest well
phrases.kannada: ಆಶೆಯಿಂದ ಕನಸು, ಸಂತೋಷದಿಂದ ಕೆಲಸ, ಚೆನ್ನಾಗಿ ವಿಶ್ರಾಂತಿ
phrases.transliteration: āśeyinda kanasu, santōṣadinda kelasa, chennāgi vishrānti

phrases.english: Turn fears into courage, one breath at time
phrases.transliteration: bhayavannu dhairyakk ē t irugisi, ond ondē usiru

phrases.english: Say kind words, listen deeply, forgive quickly
phrases.kannada: ಒಳ್ಳೆಯ ಮಾತಾಡಿ, ಆಳವಾಗಿ ಕೇಳಿ, ಬೇಗ ಕ್ಷಮಿಸಿ

phrases.english: Stay focused, remove distractions, finish strong
phrases.kannada: ಗಮನ ಕೇಂದ್ರೀಕರಿಸಿ, ತಡೆಗಳನ್ನು ತೆಗೆದು, ಬಲವಾಗಿ ಮುಗಿಸಿ

phrases.english: Celebrate small wins, keep moving forward

phrases.english: I’m grateful, for this moment, right now
Your support helped me, I’m thankful
phrases.kannada: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಬೆಂಬಲ ನನಗೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡಿತು, ನಾನು ಕೃತಜ್ಞ

phrases.english: Thank you, for being patient, with me
I appreciate you, for your time, today
Grateful heart, for every small good thing
Breathe first, then choose your next step
phrases.kannada: ಮೊದಲು ಉಸಿರು ಬಿಡಿ, ನಂತರ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮುಂದಿನ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆ ಆರಿಸಿ
phrases.transliteration: modalu usiru bidi, nantara nimma mundina hejje aarisi

phrases.english: Small progress, every day, builds strong habits

phrases.english: Calm mind, clear goals, steady action
phrases.kannada: ಶಾಂತ ಮನಸ್ಸು, ಸ್ಪಷ್ಟ ಗುರಿ, ಸ್ಥಿರ ಕ್ರಮ

phrases.english: Learn slowly, practice daily, improve naturally
Let mistakes teach you, keep going
Nice to meet you, let's talk gently.
Good night, rest well, see you soon.

phrases.transliteration: śubha rātri, chennāgi viśrānti māḍi, bēga nōḍōṇa.

phrases.english: Hey, greetings today, how can I help?
phrases.kannada: ಹೇ, ಇಂದು ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ, ನಾನು ಹೇಗೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡಲಿ?
phrases.transliteration: hē, indu namaskāra, nānu hēge sahāya māḍali?

phrases.english: Peace be with you, have a calm day.
May you be happy, enjoy your day!
Mom, I’m on my way home.
Dad, can you help me now?
My parents, thank you for everything.
Brother, are you free right now?
Say please, it changes the day.
Small wins today, big confidence tomorrow.
phrases.kannada: ಇಂದು ಸಣ್ಣ ಗೆಲುವು, ನಾಳೆ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಆತ್ಮವಿಶ್ವಾಸ.

phrases.english: Stay kind to yourself, keep learning.
One more try, you’ll notice change.
Relax your jaw, soften your face.

phrases.english: Feel the air, move through you.

phrases.transliteration: dayavittu, nanage ondu filter kāfi kodi.

phrases.english: Is this food spicy, or mild?
What curry goes with rice today?
phrases.transliteration: indu akki ge yāva grevi ide?

phrases.english: Could we get the bill, please?
You're my favorite person, today and always.
phrases.kannada: ನೀವು ನನ್ನ ಪ್ರಿಯ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿ, ಇಂದು ಮತ್ತು ಸದಾ.
phrases.transliteration: Nīvu nanna priya vyakti, indu mattu sadā.

phrases.english: Your smile makes my day better.
I can count on you, friend.
phrases.kannada: ನಿನ್ನ ಮೇಲೆ ನಾನು ನಂಬಿಕೆ ಇಟ್ಟುಕೊಳ್ಳಬಹುದು, ಸ್ನೇಹಿತ.
phrases.transliteration: Ninna mēle nānu nambike iṭṭukoḷḷabahudu, snēhit.

phrases.english: Yes, I understand what you mean.

phrases.kannada: ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡಿ, ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು. ನನಗೆ ಈಗ ಸಹಾಯ ಬೇಕು.
phrases.transliteration: sahaya maadi, dayavittu. nanage eega sahaya beku

phrases.english: Call an ambulance, please, right now.
Are you hurt? Call help immediately.
phrases.kannada: ನೀವು ಗಾಯಗೊಂಡಿದ್ದೀರಾ? ತಕ್ಷಣ ಸಹಾಯ ಕರೆ ಮಾಡಿ.

phrases.english: Fire! Get out of here now.

Your smile, calms my restless mind.
phrases.kannada: ನಿನ್ನ ನಗು, ನನ್ನ ಅಶಾಂತ ಮನಸ್ಸನ್ನು ಶಮನಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
phrases.transliteration: Ninna nagu, nanna aśānta manassannu śamanisuttade.

phrases.english: I feel safe with you, always.
phrases.kannada: ನಿನ್ನ ಜೊತೆಗಿರುವಾಗ ನನಗೆ ಸದಾ ಸುರಕ್ಷಿತ ಅನ್ನಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.
phrases.transliteration: Ninna jote iruvāga nanage sadā surakṣit annisuttade.

phrases.english: Let’s hold hands, and feel love.

phrases.kannada: ನಮ್ಮ ನಡುವೆ ಇರುವ ಮೌನವೂ ತುಂಬಾ ಸಿಹಿಯಾಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ.

phrases.english: Feel light today, breathe easy, smile softly.

phrases.english: Let good thoughts rise, gently, every day.

phrases.transliteration: olley suddi, bechchina hrudaya, sithiravada santhosha

phrases.english: Hug someone, feel happiness come quickly.

Good morning, how is your day going?

phrases.kannada: ನಾನು ಕನ್ನಡ ಕಲಿಯುತ್ತಿದ್ದೇನೆ, ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ ಮಾತನಾಡಿ.
phrases.transliteration: Nānū kannada kaliyuttiddēne, dayavittu nidhānavāgi māḍi.

phrases.english: Do you have an English menu?

phrases.transliteration: Sambhāṣaṇeyallū sahā nānu dayeyannu āyke māḍuttēne.

phrases.english: I speak slowly, so I’m understood.
I thank you often, with sincerity.
phrases.kannada: ನಾನು ನಿಜವಾದ ಮನಸ್ಸಿನಿಂದ ಹೆಚ್ಚಾಗಿ ಧನ್ಯವಾದ ಹೇಳುತ್ತೇನೆ.

phrases.english: I ask for help, without hesitation.
You’ve got this, keep practicing daily.
Trust your rhythm, start speaking today.
phrases.kannada: ನಿಮ್ಮ ರಿದಮ್‌ ಮೇಲೆ ನಂಬಿಕೆ, ಇಂದು ಮಾತನಾಡಿ.
phrases.transliteration: nim'ma ridam-me mēle nambike, indu mātāḍi

phrases.english: Even slow progress, you’re moving forward.

phrases.kannada: ತಪ್ಪು ಮಾಡಿ, ನಂತರ ನಗು ಮಾಡಿ ಮುಂದುವರಿಯಿರಿ.

phrases.english: One conversation at a time, you grow.

phrases.transliteration: ondu hosa sketch maadi, eegale, dayavittu

phrases.english: Add one detail, and watch it change.

phrases.transliteration: ondu sanna vivara serisi, nodi badalāvaṇe

phrases.english: Pause, then draw what you feel.
phrases.kannada: ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ನಿಲ್ಲಿಸಿ, ನಂತರ ನಿಮಗೆ ಅನ್ನಿಸುವುದನ್ನು ಬಿಡಿಸಿ.
phrases.transliteration: svalpa nillisi, naantara nimage annisuvudannu biḍisi

phrases.english: Choose a color, and trust your mood.
phrases.kannada: ಒಂದು ಬಣ್ಣ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಮಾಡಿ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಮನಸ್ಸನ್ನೇ ನಂಬಿ.
phrases.transliteration: ondu baṇṇa ayke maadi, nimma manasannu nambi

phrases.english: I’m so glad you’re here, today.
phrases.kannada: ನೀವು ಇಂದು ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಇರುವುದಕ್ಕೆ ನನಗೆ ತುಂಬಾ ಸಂತೋಷ.
phrases.transliteration: nīvu indu illi iruvudakke nanage tumba santōṣa

phrases.english: Joy is in the little moments.

I’m grateful, and my heart sings.
Relax your shoulders, let peace arrive.
phrases.kannada: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಭುಜಗಳನ್ನು ಸಡಿಲ ಮಾಡಿ, ಶಾಂತಿ ಬರುಲಿ.
phrases.transliteration: nim'ma bhujagaḷannu saḍila māḍi, shānti baruli

phrases.english: Sit quietly, feel the gentle moment.

phrases.english: Slow down, then you’ll see clearly.

Hold hope, even on hard days.

phrases.transliteration: nanu indu bēga sudhārisabahudu endu nambiddēne

phrases.english: I’m ready to try another sentence.

phrases.transliteration: Svalpa jāga biḍi, dayē ellegū honduttade.

phrases.english: Focus on one phrase, then move.
phrases.kannada: ಒಂದು ವಾಕ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಗಮನ ಕೊಡು, ನಂತರ ಮುಂದೆ.
phrases.transliteration: ondu vākyakke gamana koḍu, nanthara munde.

phrases.english: Talk with others, learn from responses.
Say it again, slowly and calmly.
Try new words, use them in sentences.
Hi! How’s everything with you today?
Good morning, hope you feel great.
Good afternoon, welcome to our place.
Hey, hope your day is going smoothly.
Hello, are you doing alright today?
I didn't mean to hurt you, sorry.
Please forgive me, I truly regret it.
phrases.kannada: ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ನನ್ನನ್ನು ಕ್ಷಮಿಸಿ, ನನಗೆ ತುಂಬಾ ವಿಷಾದ.
phrases.transliteration: Dayavittu nannannu kshamisi, nanage tumbaa vishaada.

phrases.english: I was wrong, please give me grace.
phrases.kannada: ನಾನು ತಪ್ಪು ಮಾಡಿದೆ, ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ಕೃಪೆ ನೀಡಿ.
phrases.transliteration: Naanu tappu maadide, dayavittu kr̥pe nīdi.

phrases.english: You matter to me, forgive me.
Let me make it right, please.
Keep your pace, you’ll improve soon.
Progress is happening, even if slow.
Small effort today, big results later.
phrases.kannada: ಇಂದು ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಪ್ರಯತ್ನ, ಮುಂದೆ ದೊಡ್ಡ ಫಲ.
phrases.transliteration: Indu swalpa prayatna, munde doḍḍa phala.

phrases.english: You’re building skills, one day at time.
Small steps build real confidence, daily.
phrases.kannada: ಚಿಕ್ಕ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆಗಳು ನಿಜವಾದ ಆತ್ಮವಿಶ್ವಾಸವನ್ನು ದಿನವೂ ಕಟ್ಟುತ್ತವೆ.
phrases.transliteration: chikka hejjegalu nijavāda ātmavishwāsavannu dinavū kattuttave.

phrases.english: Ask questions, the answer comes closer.
You’re learning, even when it’s messy.
Celebrate effort, not just final results.
Relax your mind, keep your rhythm.
phrases.kannada: ಮನಸ್ಸು ಹಗುರ ಮಾಡಿ, ನಿಮ್ಮ ಲಯ ಕಾಯ್ದುಕೊಳ್ಳಿ.
phrases.transliteration: manassu hagura māḍi, nim'ma laya kāydukoḷḷi.

phrases.english: Relax your shoulders, just for a moment.
Softly inhale, feel the air arrive.
Exhale gently, and let your mind clear.
Notice your breath, without forcing it.
Could you tell me the time, please?
Is it early or late right now?
The bus leaves at six thirty.
My watch is slow, I think.
What time does the shop open?
Thanks for helping me today, really.
phrases.kannada: ಇಂದು ನನ್ನಿಗೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡಿದಕ್ಕೆ ಧನ್ಯವಾದಗಳು, ನಿಜವಾಗಿ.
phrases.transliteration: indu nanage sahaya madida ke dhanyavādagaḷu, nijavāgi

phrases.english: I’m thankful for your quick help.
You made things easier for me.
I’m grateful for your kind words.
Wait quietly, let it settle first.
Be patient, listen and observe calmly.
Slow down, it will work out.
No hurry, today will still be good.
Can I get seven glasses, please?
Give me ten rupees for now.
We need eleven chairs for guests.

phrases.kannada: ಇತರರಿಗೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡಿ, ನಿಮಗೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡಿ.
phrases.transliteration: itararige sahaaya maadi, nimage sahaaya maadi

phrases.english: Train daily, become stronger day by day.
phrases.kannada: ಪ್ರತಿದಿನ ತರಬೇತಿ ಮಾಡಿ, ದಿನೇ ದಿನೇ ಬಲವಾಗಿ.
phrases.transliteration: Pratidina tarabeti maadi, dîne dîne balavāgi.

phrases.english: Take charge, even when it's tough.
Keep your head up, stay steady.
Try small steps, but never stop.
Say no to doubt, choose effort.

phrases.transliteration: Moṇakal u vagi, nimma gamana irali.
Saavakaasha vāgi usiru bidi, nelavannu bhaavisi.

phrases.english: Be fearless in small moments, today.
When you hesitate, breathe and act.
phrases.kannada: ನೀವು ಅಲುಗಾಡಿದಾಗ, ಉಸಿರು ತೆಗೆದು ಕಾರ್ಯ ಮಾಡಿ.
phrases.transliteration: nīvu alugāḍidāga, usiru tegedu kārya māḍi.

phrases.english: Courage grows, one choice at a time.
Say it plainly, even if it’s hard.
Go ahead, even with shaky hands.
You make hard days feel easier.
phrases.transliteration: Kas.tada dina gaLu su la ba vā guttu vaye niminda.

phrases.english: I’m grateful for your honest advice.
phrases.transliteration: Ninna nija vā da salah ege naanu kr̥tajña.

phrases.english: Your laugh lifts my mood instantly.
phrases.kannada: ನಿನ್ನ ನಗು ನನ್ನ ಮನಸ್ಥಿತಿಯನ್ನು ತಕ್ಷಣ ಎತ್ತುತ್ತದೆ.
phrases.transliteration: Ninna nagu nanna manasthitiyan-nu takshana ettuttade.

phrases.english: We celebrate even small wins together.
phrases.transliteration: Saṇṇa geluvu gaLan nū kūda naavu ā chari suttēve.
Namma raatri mā toku tegaLu nanage ishta.

phrases.english: Can you show me this place?
Is there a nearby pharmacy, please?
Do you have a smaller size?
I want to buy this, please.
I choose you, again and again.
phrases.kannada: ನಾನು ನಿನ್ನನ್ನು ಮತ್ತೆ ಮತ್ತೆ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತೇನೆ.
phrases.transliteration: Naanu ninnannu matte matte ayke maaduttēne.

phrases.english: Your smile lights up my day.
Your voice feels like home to me.
I feel lucky, because it’s you.
Stay close, and I’ll be okay.
Quickly, is there a doctor nearby?
I fell, please help me here.
phrases.kannada: ನಾನು ಬಿದ್ದೆ, ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ಇಲ್ಲಿ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡಿ.
phrases.transliteration: Nānu biddē, dayavittu illi sahāya māḍi.

phrases.english: My chest hurts, please come fast.
phrases.kannada: ನನ್ನ ಎದೆ ನೋವು ಬರುತ್ತಿದೆ, ಬೇಗ ಬನ್ನಿ.
phrases.transliteration: Nanna ede nōvu baruttide, bēga bann̄i.

phrases.english: Good morning, where is the station?
I need a ticket to Mysuru, please.
Can I pay by card here?
Is this the right road to downtown?
Where can I get drinking water?
I’m hungry, can I order now?
Is the idli fresh this morning?
Can I get plain rice, please?
I’m smiling from ear to ear today.
Today feels bright, like a fresh start.
Good vibes are here, keep them coming.
I can’t wait to share this joy.
My day is peaceful, and joyful.
I breathe, and my thoughts slow down.
May my heart stay warm and steady.
I choose calm, even when busy.
Use it daily, let Kannada grow.
Your voice matters, start speaking now.
Confidence comes with real practice, keep.
phrases.transliteration: nijaavada abhyasadinda atma vishvasa barutade, munduvarisi

phrases.english: Even one sentence today is enough.
Let curiosity guide you, not fear.
phrases.kannada: ಕುತೂಹಲ ನಿನಗೆ ಮಾರ್ಗ ತೋರಲಿ, ಭಯ ಬೇಡ.
phrases.transliteration: kutuhala ninage marga torali, bhaya beda

phrases.kannada: ನೀನು ಮಾಡುವ ಮೊದಲು ಉದ್ದೇಶ ನಿಗದಿ ಮಾಡು.
phrases.transliteration: neeU maduv munnade uddeesha nigadi maaDu

phrases.english: Stop comparing, start focusing on you.
Make time for what matters most.
phrases.transliteration: ati mUkhya vaadaddakke samaya meesalu maaDu

phrases.english: Turn a simple idea into something.
Let your curiosity guide your next step.
phrases.transliteration: Ninna kutoohalavē mundina hejjē tōral i.

phrases.english: Try a new approach, quietly, today.
Share your craft, even if small.
Make room for mistakes, then improve.
phrases.kannada: ತಪ್ಪುಗಳಿಗೆ ಜಾಗ ಕೊಡು, ನಂತರ ಉತ್ತಮ ಮಾಡು.
phrases.transliteration: Tappugaḷige jāga koḍu, naṃtara uttama māḍu.

phrases.english: I want to introduce myself confidently.
I aim to thank people sincerely.
phrases.kannada: ನಾನು ಜನರಿಗೆ ಹೃದಯಪೂರ್ವಕವಾಗಿ ಧನ್ಯವಾದ ಹೇಳಲು ಉದ್ದೇಶಿಸುತ್ತೇನೆ.
phrases.transliteration: Naanu janarige hr̥dayapūrvakavagi dhanyavaada hēḷalu uddaēshisuttēne.

phrases.english: I try to use polite words.
I listen first, then I answer.
I practice greeting in real situations.
phrases.kannada: ನಿಜ ಜೀವನದಲ್ಲಿ ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ ಹೇಳಲು ಅಭ್ಯಾಸ ಮಾಡುತ್ತೇನೆ.
phrases.transliteration: Nija jeevanadalli namaskāra hēḷalu abhyāsa maaduttēne.

phrases.english: Slow is smooth, keep going kindly.
Humble people learn faster, day by day.
Before helping others, learn their pace.
phrases.kannada: ಇತರರಿಗೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುವ ಮುನ್ನ ಅವರ ವೇಗ ತಿಳಿಯಿರಿ.
phrases.transliteration: itarige sahāya māḍuva munna avara vēga tiḷiyiri

phrases.english: Small doubts, big wisdom grows inside.
phrases.transliteration: saṇṇa saṁśayallē doḍḍa jñāna beḷedu baruttade

phrases.english: There is light after the storm.
Hope, even when things feel stuck.
You’re getting better, day by day.
Don’t rush, steady progress will come.
Good job, you’re on the right path.

phrases.kannada: ಪ್ರತಿ ದಿನ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸ ಮಾಡಿ, ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ ಬರುತ್ತದೆ.
phrases.transliteration: prati dina abhyasa maadi, phalitānsha baruttade

phrases.english: When it’s tough, keep your calm.
Keep showing up, even on bad days.

phrases.transliteration: usirechchu, nim'ma gavaḍannu mṛduvāgi saḍilis u.

phrases.english: Feel your chest rise and fall.
phrases.transliteration: nim'ma ede-yu ēri iḷiyuvudannu anubhavis u.

phrases.english: Slow down, notice the room around you.
I like this place a lot.
Do you have this in blue?
Show up today, learn something useful.
Notice words, then try to use them.
Repeat, but also listen to meaning.
Don’t rush, let it sink in.
Start where you are, one word.
Practice daily, even for a minute.
Confidence grows when you keep speaking.

phrases.transliteration: ee ga samāsvādu aidu hadinaidu āgide

phrases.english: Please, tell me the time, okay?
I need to know the time.
Wait with a kind heart, please.
Stay patient, the answer needs time.
phrases.transliteration: thaaLm e iri, uththarakke samaya beku.

phrases.english: Let it mature, don't force it.
Be steady, even when delays happen.
Give it space, then watch it.
phrases.transliteration: sva lp a jaaga ni di, nanthara noodi.

phrases.english: Hello! How are you feeling today?
Hi there, welcome to my home.
Good morning! Hope you’re doing well.
Good evening! Are you free right now?
phrases.kannada: ಶುಭ ಸಂಜೆ! ಈಗ ನಿಮಗೆ ಸಮಯ ಇದೆಯಾ?
phrases.transliteration: śubha sañje! īga nimage samaya ideyā?

phrases.english: Do you have bags for shopping?
Is this price fixed, or negotiable?
phrases.kannada: ಈ ಬೆಲೆ ಫಿಕ್ಸ್ ಆಗಿದೆಯಾ, ಅಥವಾ ಮಾತುಕತೆನಾ?
phrases.transliteration: ee bele fix agideya, athava matukate-na?

phrases.english: You’re doing better than you think, today.
Take a deep breath, and begin gently.
phrases.kannada: ಒಂದು ಆಳ ಉಸಿರು ತಗೆದು, ನಿಧಾನವಾಗಿ ಶುರುಮಾಡಿ.
phrases.transliteration: ondu aala usiru tegedu, nidhana vagi shurumaadi.

phrases.english: Trust yourself, one small step now.
phrases.kannada: ನಿನ್ನನ್ನು ನಂಬು, ಈಗ ಒಂದು ಚಿಕ್ಕ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆ.
phrases.transliteration: ninnannu nambu, ega ondu chikka hejjje.

phrases.english: Say it kindly, even when it’s hard.
Rest your mind, you’ll feel lighter.
Sorry, I didn’t mean it that way.
Please, forgive me for the upset.
I own it, please forgive me.
Please let this go, I’m sorry.
I’m sorry, I understand your hurt.
I cherish you, more than words.
Come close, and let my heart smile.
phrases.kannada: ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಹತ್ತಿರ ಬಾ, ನನ್ನ ಹೃದಯ ನಗಲಿ.
phrases.transliteration: Svalpa haṭṭira bā, nanna hr̥daya nagali.

phrases.english: Your laughter feels like sweet rain to me.
I’m yours, with my whole soul.
Every day, I want you beside me.
Happiness starts with a kind thought.
Let today feel lighter, step by step.
phrases.kannada: ಇಂದು ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಹಗುರವಾಗಲಿ, ಹೆಜ್ಜೆ ಹೆಜ್ಜೆ.
phrases.transliteration: indu swalpa swalpa haguravagali, hejje hejje

phrases.english: Choose to smile, even when it’s hard.
Thank the moment, and move forward.
Breathe slow, your heart will ease.
Where is the taxi stand, please?
I’m looking for the departure gate.
What time does the bus leave?
Does this bus go to the city?
I want four tickets for today.
Courage starts right now, with you.
Keep your chin up, breathe, and go.
Take a deep breath, choose brave.
I’m thrilled, and I feel it.
phrases.kannada: ನನಗೆ ತುಂಬಾ ಹರ್ಷ, ಮತ್ತು ಅದನ್ನು ಭಾಸವಾಗುತ್ತಿದೆ.
phrases.transliteration: nanage tumbaa harṣa, mattu adannu bhasavaaguttide

phrases.kannada: ಒಳ್ಳೆ ಸುದ್ದಿ, ನನಗೆ ಈಗಲೇ ನಗು ಬರುತ್ತಿದೆ.
phrases.transliteration: oḷḷe suddi, nanage igaaley nagu baruttide

phrases.english: Excuse me, what time is it?
I’m looking for this shop, please.
How much does this cost, ma’am?
I’m glad you stepped in, today.
I needed this, thanks a lot.
Thanks for your patience, I noticed.
You’re always kind, and I feel it.
I will speak, even if imperfect.
I choose confidence, one sentence at a time.
phrases.kannada: ನಾನು ಆತ್ಮವಿಶ್ವಾಸ ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಮಾಡುತ್ತೇನೆ, ಒಂದೊಂದು ವಾಕ್ಯದಲ್ಲಿ.
phrases.transliteration: naanu atmavishvaasa ayke maaduttēne, ondondu vaakyadaalli.

phrases.english: My accent is okay, I keep going.
I can ask for help, politely.
I know practice improves my listening too.
